description: Lists the events picker.on(event, handler) can subscribe to, with the payload type and its fields, extracted from source. Internal and deprecated events are left out unless asked for.

includeDeprecated.description: Also list deprecated events such as hide, select:am and select:pm.

includeInternal.description: Also list internal events (open:request, range:minute:commit, animation:*). 5.0 removes them from the event map.

name: list_events
title: List timepicker-ui events
